title: Published shared-package graph contains consumers of absent data subpaths
auth_mode: guest/member/admin; package CI is independent of sign-in
preconditions: Use extension CI run 38257589484 with published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 and @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23.
The run reached unit tests against the current published package graph.
reproduction: Run extension CI run 38257589484 with @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 and @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23 in the dependency graph.
Observe four unit-test suites fail with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.
Trace the package error to published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62/dist/host/diagnostics.js importing @ai-matrx/data/net, a subpath not exported by @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23.
expected: The latest published shared-package graph exports every subpath imported by its dependents, so extension unit tests and mandatory CI pass. A stale or incompatible package graph is identified before it reaches release acceptance.
actual: The original CI run 38257589484 failed four unit suites because chat@0.8.62 imported the absent data/net subpath. Chat@0.8.63 corrected that import, but exact-source CI 38260278753 then found 12 analogous imports in agents@0.59.75 during the WXT build. Agents@0.59.76 removed those imports. An agents-only adoption at 06507f41b failed postinstall because direct data@0.29.23 and transitive data@0.29.24 coexisted. Commit 760643087 synchronized the complete 25-package graph. At that exact SHA, full CI 38261957044 and focused acceptance 38261957050 succeeded, including unit tests and the keyed development artifact build. This establishes package/build recovery; it does not establish browser behavior or Store acceptance.
cause: Published chat@0.8.62 and agents@0.59.75 retained imports of a data/net subpath removed from current @ai-matrx/data, while an intermediate extension adoption left duplicate direct/transitive data versions. Corrected chat@0.8.63, agents@0.59.76, and a synchronized extension lockfile resolve the package graph.
severity: S2: required unit CI and release validation are blocked; no product runtime impact has been established.
priority: P0: unblock current CI and release validation by publishing and adopting a compatible latest package graph.
evidence: Public @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.63 tarball: dist/host/diagnostics.js imports @ai-matrx/api/net; scan of 1,553 dist JavaScript files found zero @ai-matrx/data/net imports.
